positions.summary: Strongly pro-Ukraine: met Zelensky in Kyiv in May 2026, pledged support 'even beyond' the war; programme keeps military and financial support as long as needed.

sources.quote: Édouard Philippe a rencontré Volodymyr Zelensky à Kyiv (headline; article reports pledge of support even beyond the war - paraphrase)
Maintenir un soutien militaire et financier à l'Ukraine tant que nécessaire

positions.nuance: Programme wording comes from an aggregator; no primary programme page found (Horizons site has no programme page). Kyiv visit corroborated by Euronews and JDD.

positions.summary: In Kyiv (May 2026) backed deploying European troops in Ukraine once peace returns, to deter renewed Russian attacks.

sources.quote: ce que des troupes européennes soient déployées en Ukraine une fois la paix revenue
support for European military presence in Ukraine after the conflict ends to deter Russian aggression (paraphrase)

positions.nuance: He speaks of European troops, and the French share is not spelled out, so coded +1. Now corroborated by a neutral outlet.

positions.summary: Atlanticist: links a strong NATO to European defence and wants Ukraine to join NATO. No sign of wanting to leave the integrated command.

sources.quote: une OTAN forte c'est une Europe de la défense plus affermie
pour que l'Ukraine puisse entrer dans l'Otan

positions.nuance: The NATO quote is from 2018. His 2026 push for Ukraine's NATO membership confirms the current Atlanticist stance. No explicit statement on the integrated command.

positions.summary: Defends Israel's right to defend itself and voiced reservations (July 2025) about recognising Palestine; no statement on the EU-Israel association agreement.

sources.quote: Israël a le droit d'exister et de se défendre
il juge la reconnaissance inopportune — les otages ne sont pas libérés (aggregator paraphrase)

positions.nuance: Inferred from adjacent statements; the main quote dates from Nov 2023.

positions.summary: Programme (per aggregator): defence budget to 3% of GDP by 2030, which meets the 3% mark without going beyond it.

sources.quote: Porter le budget de la défense à 3 % du PIB d'ici 2030 et reconstituer des stocks de munitions

positions.nuance: The statement asks for MORE than 3%, and his target is exactly 3% by 2030, so this is partial support (+1). Aggregator wording, not a primary programme.

positions.summary: Proposes expanding voluntary military service (3,000 to 50,000 places a year) and reservists (45,000 to 250,000), with no compulsory service.

sources.quote: le service militaire volontaire de 3 000 à 50 000 places par an

positions.nuance: In 2023 he wondered whether conscription might become necessary (MonVote2027). His current programme is voluntary. Aggregator only.

positions.summary: Firm line on Moscow and calls abandoning Ukraine a betrayal; no explicit statement on lifting sanctions for a peace deal.

sources.quote: L'abandon d'un pays qu'on soutient, qui est attaqué...c'est évidemment une trahison.
refus d'une reprise du dialogue sans conditions (aggregator, indirect source)

positions.nuance: Inferred only. 'Without conditions' leaves room for conditional dialogue, and as PM he received Medvedev (2019).

positions.summary: As PM his government passed the Loi d'orientation des mobilités (Dec 2019), which set up the mobility low-emission zones (ZFE-m); no current statement found.

sources.quote: LOI n° 2019-1428 du 24 décembre 2019 d'orientation des mobilités

positions.nuance: Based only on his record (he was PM when the LOM was enacted). No 2025-26 statement on the ZFE abolition votes was found. Web search budget was exhausted, so the check was limited.

positions.summary: Reported as refusing pesticide bans without alternatives, as in the glyphosate file under his government.

sources.quote: il refuse d'interdire des pesticides sans alternative disponible, comme lors du dossier glyphosate sous son gouvernement

positions.nuance: MonVote2027 says he 'voted for' the Duplomb law (July 2025). That cannot be right: he has not been a deputy since 2020. At most the Horizons group voted for it. Indirect aggregator source.

positions.summary: Reported as reserved about the 2035 ban on new combustion cars and wanting it relaxed for industrial realism.

sources.quote: Réservé sur l'interdiction des véhicules thermiques neufs en 2035, qu'il souhaite assouplir

positions.nuance: Only one indirect aggregator source. MonVote2027 found no explicit position.

positions.summary: Aggregator reports him against heavier air taxation on competitiveness and purchasing-power grounds.

sources.quote: Opposé à un alourdissement de la fiscalité sur l'aérien, par souci de compétitivité et de pouvoir d'achat

positions.nuance: Indirect source. As PM in 2019 his government did bring in an eco-contribution on plane tickets (EUR 1.50-18, per MonVote2027), a modest increase.

positions.summary: Pragmatic: supports decarbonisation but resists bans without alternatives; does not put climate ahead of growth.

sources.quote: refuse d'interdire des pesticides sans alternative disponible (adjacent position)

positions.nuance: Inferred from adjacent positions only.

positions.summary: Programme: 6 EPR2 followed by a second series of 8 reactors.

sources.quote: Lancer la construction de 6 réacteurs EPR2, puis d'une seconde série de 8
La France aura plus de nucléaire

positions.nuance: Aggregator wording. votons-2027.fr also has 'en relançant le nucléaire'.

positions.summary: Firmly pro-nuclear: 'La France aura plus de nucléaire' (April 2026).

sources.quote: La France aura plus de nucléaire...plus de renouvelables, plus de souveraineté

positions.nuance: Consistent with his career (former Areva executive) and his EPR2 programme.

positions.summary: Wants to develop offshore wind and solar, so opposes halting new wind turbines.

sources.quote: Développer en parallèle l'éolien en mer et le solaire, sans saturer les paysages

positions.nuance: 'Sans saturer les paysages' signals restraint on onshore wind, but nothing suggests a halt. Aggregator wording.

positions.summary: Pro-European; aggregator estimates he opposes leaving the EU electricity market unilaterally.

sources.quote: il n'est pas favorable à une sortie unilatérale du marché européen de l'électricité (position estimée)

positions.nuance: The aggregator labels this an estimate.

positions.summary: Rejects a Sixth Republic and wants to return to the sources of the Fifth.

sources.quote: Pas question...de passer à la VIe République
revenir aux sources de notre Ve République

positions.nuance: The explicit refusal dates from 2018. The 'sources of the Fifth' line points the same way.

positions.summary: Warned in May 2025 that proportional representation would perpetuate the lack of a majority; the programme reportedly offers only 'une dose de proportionnelle'.

sources.quote: Le scrutin proportionnel...perpétuer une absence de majorité
Introduire une dose de proportionnelle aux élections législatives

positions.nuance: He rejects full PR, while a partial dose may be in the programme. Coded -1 (partial opposition).

positions.summary: Hostile to the RIC: 'ça me hérisse' (2019).

sources.quote: ça me hérisse

positions.nuance: Dated (2019, during the Gilets jaunes). No sign of a change since.

positions.summary: As PM he used 49.3 for the pension reform (Feb-Mar 2020) and opposes abolishing it.

sources.quote: Used it; opposes suppression (page summary)

positions.nuance: His 2020 use of 49.3 is well documented. No recent statement on restricting it.

positions.summary: Wants to govern by referendum (pensions, budget rule), but no evidence on widening its scope to immigration or justice.

sources.quote: il annonce vouloir gouverner en recourant au référendum, notamment pour la règle d'or budgétaire

positions.nuance: His proposed referendums (pensions, budget rule) do not need a wider scope. No statement on immigration or justice referendums found.

positions.summary: Reported (2025) as not wanting aide à mourir written into law; another aggregator says he is open to very tightly regulated aid but has reservations about the parliamentary text.

sources.quote: ne pas souhaiter que l'aide à mourir soit inscrite dans la loi
ouvert à une aide à mourir très encadrée selon certaines sources, mais il a exprimé des réserves sur le texte (position estimée)

positions.nuance: Aggregators conflict. The more specific 2025 quote points against. Not checked against a primary interview.

positions.summary: Says a general ban on the headscarf would be contrary to French laïcité (2025).

sources.quote: Interdire le voile...serait contraire à la laïcité

positions.summary: Aggregator: firm on laïcité in public services but opposed to extending bans on religious symbols.

sources.quote: ferme sur la laïcité dans les services publics, mais opposé à l'extension des interdictions de signes religieux

positions.nuance: Draft had null. The aggregator gives a general position against extending bans (indirect source). No specific statement on school-trip parents or universities was verified.

positions.summary: Frames laïcité as state neutrality, not uniformity, and opposes extending religious-symbol bans; firm on public services and against separatism.

sources.quote: neutralité de l'État, non l'uniformisation
opposé à l'extension des interdictions de signes religieux

positions.nuance: +1 rather than +2 because he also backs tougher anti-separatism measures. Aggregator only.

positions.summary: No position on surrogacy found.

sources.quote: GPA: No clear position stated

positions.nuance: MonVote2027 also lists no GPA position. He supported extending PMA in 2018.

positions.summary: Programme lets school heads impose a uniform; no national obligation.

sources.quote: liberté d'adapter les méthodes et les horaires, d'imposer l'uniforme

positions.nuance: Partial: a school-level option, not mandatory everywhere.

positions.summary: Puts teacher pay rises tied to commitments first; no mass hiring or class-size plan found.

sources.quote: Revalorisation salariale des enseignants liée à un engagement renforcé

positions.nuance: Inferred from the absence of hiring pledges and his focus on spending discipline.

positions.summary: Favours school autonomy and a back-to-basics focus; no direct statement on ability groups.

sources.quote: Proposes increased establishment autonomy; 50 excellence lycées (page summary)

positions.nuance: Inferred. Groupes de niveau were adopted by the Attal government (2023-24), which Horizons supported; Philippe was not in it.

positions.summary: Aggregator estimate: attached to freedom of education and opposed to cutting public funding of contracted private schools.

sources.quote: il est opposé à une réduction du financement public de l'enseignement privé (position estimée)

positions.nuance: Estimate only. MonVote2027 found no position. The statement's social-mix conditionality is not addressed.

positions.summary: Parcoursup was created under his government (2018 ORE law); he defends it and opposes abolition.

sources.quote: Created under his government (2018 ORE law); opposes abolition but open to adjustments

positions.nuance: His record is well established. Open to adjustments.

positions.summary: Tackles medical deserts with strong installation incentives and more maisons de santé, without coercion.

sources.quote: Lutter contre les déserts médicaux par de fortes incitations à l'installation
doubled maisons de santé with liberal physicians (page summary)

positions.nuance: Choosing incentives implies no compulsion. No explicit rejection of mandatory installation found.

positions.summary: No evidence on raising patient co-payments; the programme talks only about stabilising health spending via prevention and technology.

sources.quote: Stabiliser les dépenses de santé en dépensant mieux, en misant sur la prévention et les transformations technologiques

positions.nuance: Presi2027's 'plutôt pour' is labelled an estimate. MonVote2027 found no explicit position.

positions.summary: Strongly opposes rent control, calling it a way to destroy a city (Dec 2025).

sources.quote: L'encadrement des loyers...meilleur moyen...de détruire une ville

positions.nuance: The quote is recent (Dec 2025), not dated.

positions.summary: Aggregator codes him 'plutôt pour' opening public services further to competition.

sources.quote: Plutôt pour (page summary)

positions.nuance: His government's 2018 rail reform (pacte ferroviaire) set the timetable for opening rail to competition. No primary source was opened for this. Current stance not explicit.

positions.summary: In March 2024 LFI voted against the France-Ukraine security accord, which included up to 3bn euros of military aid. Mélenchon regretted EU arms deliveries in 2022, calling them co-belligerence. The 2027 programme focuses on a diplomatic framework for a ceasefire and says nothing about military aid.

sources.quote: Paraphrase of headline: the Assemblée voted for the Franco-Ukrainian security accord; RN and LFI opposed it (article body not reachable).
Je regrette que l'Union européenne ait décidé de fournir des armements nécessaires à une guerre
En Ukraine, agir pour créer un cadre diplomatique permettant d'obtenir un cessez-le-feu, le retrait des troupes russes

positions.nuance: No explicit 2025-2026 statement against arms deliveries was found. The 2024 vote was a non-binding Article 50-1 consultation. The 2027 programme is silent on aid, so -2 rests on 2022-2024 evidence and confidence is lowered to medium.

positions.summary: He would accept interposition troops only under UN authority and UN military command, and opposes a NATO or coalition-of-the-willing deployment.

sources.quote: Paraphrase: if troops were deployed to interpose and guarantee peace, they could only be under UN authority and its military command.

positions.nuance: His openness to a UN force is conditional, and he rejects the French/European format the statement implies. Coded -1 rather than 0.

positions.summary: The programme calls for leaving NATO's integrated command immediately, then the organisation itself in stages.

sources.quote: Se retirer immédiatement du commandement intégré de l'OTAN puis, par étapes, de l'organisation elle-même

positions.nuance: Consistent with L'Avenir en commun 2022.

positions.summary: The programme calls for sanctions on the Netanyahu government, ending economic cooperation agreements with Israel and an arms embargo. LFI also backed a European Citizens' Initiative to suspend the EU-Israel association agreement.

sources.quote: interrompre les accords de coopération économique avec Israël et décréter un embargo sur les armes
L'économie d'Israël ne peut pas vivre sans l'Europe. Ils auraient été obligés d'arrêter le carnage

positions.nuance: The position is well established in both the programme and recent statements.

positions.summary: No explicit position on a 3% target was found. The programme prioritises a public arms sector and non-alignment. He has asked whether war debt is a subsidy to capitalism.

sources.quote: Paraphrase: questions whether war debt is anything other than a subsidy to capitalism in crisis.
Créer un pôle public de l'armement, stopper les privatisations des industries d'armement

positions.nuance: The programme sets no spending figure. -1 is an inference, so confidence is low.

positions.summary: The programme creates a compulsory nine-month citizen service ('conscription citoyenne') for under-25s, paid at the SMIC. Military service is an optional part of that compulsory service.

sources.quote: Ouvrir la possibilité d'un service militaire comme composante optionnelle du service citoyen obligatoire
Paraphrase: nine-month citizen conscription for under-25s, men and women, paid at revalued SMIC.

positions.nuance: The statement says 'military OR national' service. He backs a compulsory national service in which the military part is optional, which is a full form of the statement.

positions.summary: In 2022 he questioned sanctions such as the SWIFT exclusion and called for negotiation. The 2027 programme seeks a ceasefire and the withdrawal of Russian troops. No explicit statement on lifting sanctions step by step for peace was found.

sources.quote: Le peuple russe n'est pas notre ennemi, ne le confondons pas avec le régime nationaliste
agir pour créer un cadre diplomatique permettant d'obtenir un cessez-le-feu, le retrait des troupes russes

positions.nuance: Evidence is mixed and old, so the code is 0 with low confidence.

positions.summary: The 2027 programme calls for a moratorium on ZFE in their current, socially unequal design. On 28 May 2025 the LFI group voted with LR, RN and UDR for the article abolishing ZFE.

sources.quote: Décréter un moratoire sur les zones à faibles émissions (ZFE) dans leur conception actuelle
adopté en séance publique le 28 mai 2025 avec le soutien de ces deux groupes, ainsi que des groupes LFI et UDR

positions.nuance: The group vote for abolition points to +2, but the newer programme speaks of a moratorium and redesign. Coded +1 on the current programme.

positions.summary: The programme bans the most dangerous pesticides (glyphosate, neonicotinoids) immediately. The summary says it also bans imports of products containing them.

sources.quote: interdire immédiatement les plus dangereux (glyphosate, néonicotinoïdes)

positions.nuance: The ban is unilateral and not conditional on foreign competitors, which matches the statement.

positions.summary: The 2027 programme has no 2035 end-of-sales position. It focuses on limiting SUVs and building light electric vehicles in France.
positions.nuance: A fetch of the climate chapter found no '2035' or 'thermique' vehicle measure. The search budget was exhausted, so EP group votes were not checked.

positions.summary: The programme ends kerosene tax exemptions and abolishes flights where a train alternative takes under four hours.

sources.quote: Mettre fin aux niches fiscales sur le kérosène
Supprimer les lignes aériennes quand l'alternative en train est inférieure à quatre heures

positions.nuance: The kerosene measure is framed around e-commerce dumping. No private-jet tax was found in the summary. The short-flight measure is a ban rather than a tax.

positions.summary: The programme rests on ecological planning and a constitutional 'règle verte': take no more from nature than it can rebuild.

sources.quote: Inscrire dans la Constitution le principe de la « règle verte »

positions.nuance: The programme does not explicitly rank climate above growth. The ranking is read from the règle verte, which as a constitutional rule overrides growth.

positions.summary: The programme exits nuclear and abandons EPR projects.

sources.quote: Sortir du nucléaire : abandonner les projets d'EPR

positions.nuance: Some LFI figures are pro-nuclear internally.

positions.summary: The programme exits nuclear and plans the dismantling and conversion of nuclear sites.

sources.quote: Sortir du nucléaire : abandonner les projets d'EPR (European Pressurized Reactor), planifier le démantèlement

positions.nuance: The phase-out is planned, which matches 'progressivement'.

positions.summary: The programme includes an emergency plan for offshore wind and secures the industry's development.

sources.quote: Mettre en œuvre un plan d'urgence pour l'éolien maritime

positions.nuance: No onshore-wind measure was found, but nothing suggests halting wind.

positions.summary: The programme cancels liberalisation of the electricity and gas market, renationalises EDF and Engie, and restores regulated tariffs based on production costs.

sources.quote: Annuler la libéralisation du marché de l'électricité et du gaz
Remettre en place des tarifs réglementés de l'énergie calculés à partir des coûts de production

positions.nuance: The summary never says 'leave the European electricity market' explicitly. The draft's 'disobey EU rules' wording was not found in the programme. National cost-based pricing is the substance of the statement, so the code stays +2 at medium confidence.

positions.summary: The programme convenes a Constituante for a Sixth Republic with 'un régime parlementaire stable'.

sources.quote: Convoquer une Constituante pour passer à la 6e République

positions.nuance: The parliamentary character is explicit in the programme.

positions.summary: The programme elects the National Assembly by proportional representation.

sources.quote: Élire l'Assemblée nationale au scrutin proportionnel

positions.nuance: None.

positions.summary: The programme creates a RIC that can recall elected officials, propose or repeal laws, and amend the Constitution.

sources.quote: Instaurer le Référendum d'initiative citoyenne

positions.nuance: None.

positions.summary: The programme's RIC can propose or repeal any law, and referendums become compulsory for constitutional changes and new EU treaties. No explicit endorsement of referendums on immigration or justice was found.

sources.quote: Rendre obligatoire le recours au référendum en cas de modification de la Constitution ou d'adoption d'un nouveau traité européen

positions.nuance: A general-purpose RIC implicitly reaches these topics, but the statement echoes a right-wing proposal on immigration that LFI does not back as such.

positions.summary: The programme abolishes forced-vote procedures such as Article 49.3.

sources.quote: Abolir les procédures de « votes forcés » du Parlement comme l'article 49.3

positions.nuance: None.

positions.summary: The programme writes into the Constitution the right to die with dignity, including with assistance, plus guaranteed palliative care.

sources.quote: mourir dans la dignité (y compris avec assistance)

positions.nuance: LFI votes on the 2025 assisted-dying bill were not verified (search budget exhausted).

positions.summary: LFI opposes restrictions on the veil in public space. The programme stresses freedom of conscience and contains no veil ban.

sources.quote: Garantir la liberté de conscience et l'application stricte de la laïcité

positions.nuance: No direct statement on a general veil ban was opened this session. The code rests on the well-known party line, so confidence is low.

positions.summary: LFI opposes extending the ban on religious symbols to parents on school trips and to universities.
positions.nuance: Not verified this session (search budget exhausted). The programme summary does not mention it.

positions.summary: LFI's laïcité centres on state neutrality and freedom of conscience. The programme pairs freedom of conscience with 'strict' laïcité aimed at state funding of religion.

sources.quote: Garantir la liberté de conscience et l'application stricte de la laïcité

positions.nuance: 'Strict' laïcité in the programme targets the state, for example no public money for religious buildings, not citizens' expression. No direct statement was opened.

positions.summary: The programme explicitly rejects surrogacy (GPA) and puts the best interest of the child first.

sources.quote: Refuser la gestation pour autrui (GPA), faire prévaloir l'intérêt supérieur de l'enfant comme principe premier

positions.nuance: The refusal is unqualified, so it also covers non-commercial GPA.

positions.summary: The programme suspends the school-uniform experiment.

sources.quote: Suspendre l'expérimentation de l'uniforme

positions.nuance: Ending even the experiment is clear opposition to making uniforms mandatory.

positions.summary: The programme cuts class sizes everywhere to beat the European average of 19 pupils, with systematic teacher hiring.

sources.quote: Réduire partout les effectifs par classe pour faire mieux que la moyenne en Europe

positions.nuance: None.

positions.summary: The programme ends ability groups in collège and keeps mixed-ability classes.

sources.quote: en mettant fin aux groupes de niveaux au collège

positions.nuance: None.

positions.summary: The programme applies a malus to public funding of contracted private schools that contribute to social segregation, and repeals the loi Carle.

sources.quote: Appliquer un malus au financement public des établissements privés sous contrat contribuant à la ségrégation socio-scolaire

positions.nuance: Nearly a word-for-word match with the statement.

positions.summary: The programme dismantles Parcoursup and guarantees selection-free university access for all bac holders.

sources.quote: Garantir à tous les bacheliers l'accès sans sélection à la formation de leur choix en démantelant le système Parcoursup

positions.nuance: None.

positions.summary: The programme regulates where doctors may set up practice, makes on-call duty compulsory and recruits salaried public doctors for under-served areas.

sources.quote: Réguler l'installation des médecins et généraliser les guichets uniques

positions.nuance: Regulating where doctors set up is a constraint on new doctors, but not explicitly a requirement to serve a few years in under-served areas. Coded +1 for this partial support.

positions.summary: The programme repeals the 2024 rise in medical co-payments and aims for '100% Sécu' coverage.

sources.quote: Abroger la hausse des franchises médicales de 2024

positions.nuance: None.

positions.summary: The programme caps rents everywhere in France and lowers them in big cities.

sources.quote: Encadrer les loyers partout sur le territoire et à la baisse dans les grandes villes

positions.nuance: This goes further than the statement, which covers only shortage areas.

positions.summary: The programme renationalises SNCF and refuses tendering of rail lines. It cancels energy-market liberalisation and renationalises EDF and Engie.

sources.quote: Paraphrase: renationalise SNCF, refuse competitive tendering of lines.
Annuler la libéralisation du marché de l'électricité et du gaz

positions.nuance: None.

result.bio: Édouard Philippe (born 1970) is a French centre-right politician and founder of Horizons (2021). He was Prime Minister under Emmanuel Macron from May 2017 to July 2020 and has been mayor of Le Havre since 2020, re-elected in March 2026. He announced his 2027 presidential candidacy in September 2024 and launched his campaign on 5 July 2026 (slogan "Croire en nous"). On 9 September 2026 he announced he would leave the Horizons presidency to build a broader coalition, and Christophe Béchu took over on 1 October 2026.

offices.office: Mayor of Le Havre (second term, re-elected 2026-03-28)
President of Le Havre Seine Métropole

legal.case: Cour de justice de la République judicial investigation into Covid-19 pandemic management (opened 7 July 2020; his home was searched on 15 October 2020). He was placed under the status of témoin assisté (assisted witness) for 'abstention de combattre un sinistre' (failure to act against a disaster), not mis en examen, and the CJR's investigating commission issued a non-lieu (dismissal) for Philippe, Agnès Buzyn and Olivier Véran on 7 July 2025. Never charged or convicted.

In 2014 the HATVP (the transparency authority) published a critical assessment of his asset declaration because of omissions, and he later filed an updated declaration. This was an administrative finding and not a criminal case.

reversals.topic: PMA (medically assisted reproduction for all women)
reversals.before: Opposed it in a 2013 tribune.
reversals.after: As PM he carried Macron's campaign pledge and said he had 'evolved on this question'.

delivery.what: 2020 pension reform (universal points system): the government used Article 49.3 at first reading in the Assemblée nationale (29 February 2020), then suspended the reform in March 2020 because of Covid. It was never adopted.
delivery.assessment: Summary-level only. The source records the 49.3 use and his later support for raising the retirement age (65-67). No balanced assessment from sources of different leanings was obtained.

delivery.what: Government of Philippe II (21 June 2017 to 3 July 2020): labour-code ordinances, laws and budgets
delivery.assessment: The page lists ordinances and laws, but the detail could not be retrieved. No cross-leaning assessments were obtained.

delivery.what: 80 km/h speed limit on secondary roads (July 2018), which he championed personally
delivery.assessment: The source says he pushed it against Macron's preference and that it may have fed Gilets jaunes tensions. No cross-leaning assessment was obtained.

result.sources_note: The WebSearch quota was exhausted in both the research and verification passes. All facts come from French Wikipedia pages that were opened and re-checked during verification: Édouard Philippe, Horizons, Gouvernement Philippe II and Cour de justice de la République. The CJR page cites a franceinfo article of 7 July 2025 for the non-lieu, but its URL could not be opened, so it is not cited directly. The profile is thin. It lacks cross-leaning outlets, the Horizons/2027 programme, trait corroboration and media portrayal, so the research should be re-run with search quota available. executive_experience_years counts mayor 2010-10 to 2017-05 (about 6.6 years), PM 2017-05 to 2020-07 (about 3.1) and mayor 2020-07 to 2026-10 (about 6.25), roughly 15.9 years in total. The metropole presidency overlaps the mayoralty and is not double-counted.

positions.summary: On 16 Sept 2026 (LCI) Le Pen said France can no longer afford to help Ukraine financially as much as now, while training Ukrainian soldiers and supplying defensive equipment can continue.

sources.quote: Mais financièrement, nous ne pouvons plus. [...] On peut continuer à former leurs soldats, leurs armées, on peut continuer à leur apporter du matériel pour pouvoir se défendre
Paraphrase: she supports stopping financial aid to Ukraine while possibly continuing equipment deliveries and training.

positions.nuance: Partial support only (training, defensive material); wants the financial effort cut. Bardella (March 2024) opposed weapons able to reach Russian territory. This is partial opposition, not full opposition, hence -1.

positions.summary: RN has consistently rejected sending French troops to Ukraine. Not re-verified live in this run.
positions.nuance: Coded from background knowledge of RN statements (2024-2025). The web search budget was exhausted and no URL could be confirmed. Needs live verification. Le Pen favours a peace conference over deployment.

positions.summary: Le Pen's 2022 manifesto calls for France to withdraw from NATO's integrated command, and a 2026 analysis reports that she still defends this. Bardella (2024) said not during wartime.

sources.outlet: M la France (Le Pen 2022 campaign manifesto)
sources.quote: cela suppose que la France se retire du commandement intégré de l'OTAN
Elle défend aussi une sortie du commandement intégré de l'OTAN.
On ne change pas les traités en période de guerre (Bardella)

positions.nuance: Le Pen's own line is exit: in the 2022 manifesto, reaffirmed per an October 2026 secondary source. Bardella (March 2024) qualified the timing, saying not while the Ukraine war continues. That is a timing caveat, not a reversal.

positions.summary: On 2 July 2025, RN deputies in the European affairs committee joined macronist and LR deputies in rejecting a resolution to denounce the EU-Israel association agreement.

sources.quote: ont fait le choix de voter un amendement de suppression de l'article unique, le rejetant de ce fait

positions.nuance: The only source is an opposing party's site describing a committee vote. The factual claim is plausible but uncorroborated. No personal Le Pen statement found. Corroboration with a neutral outlet was not possible because the search budget was exhausted.

positions.summary: Her targets have varied: the 2017 programme aimed at 3% of GDP by 2022, while the 2022 programme aimed at EUR 55bn by 2027 (about 2% of GDP). In 2026 the RN supports higher military budgets but stresses public-finance limits. No current commitment above 3% was found.

sources.outlet: M la France (Le Pen 2022 campaign site)
sources.quote: Porter le budget de la défense à 55 milliards d'euros à l'horizon 2027
augmenter le budget de la défense pour le porter à 2 % du PIB dès 2018 et à 3 % du PIB en 2022
Le Rassemblement national a soutenu la hausse du budget militaire

positions.nuance: No programme has ever gone above 3%: the 2017 target was exactly 3%, and the 2022 target was about 2%. In 2026 she says Ukraine aid must be cut for budget reasons, which suggests limits on defence spending too. The record is mixed; await the 2027 programme.

positions.summary: Her 2017 programme proposed reinstating a compulsory three-month service, mainly civil and civic. The 2022 manifesto has no general compulsory service, only an extension of the overseas 'service militaire adapté'. No 2025-2026 position was found.

sources.quote: rétabli à l'horizon de la fin du quinquennat un service militaire obligatoire de trois mois, principalement civil et civique

positions.nuance: Old evidence (2017). The service was short and mainly civic, hence only +1. It was absent from the 2022 programme, so the current position is uncertain.

positions.summary: Le Pen has called sanctions on Russia useless and counterproductive (older statements). A 2026 position on lifting them in exchange for a peace deal is not verified.

sources.quote: Le Pen réclame l'abandon des sanctions contre la Russie, qui «ne servent à rien» (headline)

positions.nuance: The source is old and could not be reopened (HTTP 403 on recheck), so the headline comes from earlier search results. After 2022 she has called for a peace conference. Her current line on sanctions is unverified, hence low confidence.

positions.summary: On 28 May 2025 the RN voted with the right to abolish the ZFE (low-emission zones), calling them territorial separatism.

sources.quote: Les ZFE sont un dispositif de séparatisme territorial (Pierre Meurin, RN)

positions.nuance: This is the group vote and statements by group members. It is consistent with Le Pen's long-standing criticism of the ZFE.

positions.summary: On 8 July 2025 the RN group voted 119-0 (2 abstentions) for the Duplomb law. The law reintroduced neonicotinoid pesticides (acetamiprid) that France had banned but other EU countries still allow.

sources.quote: RN group: pour 119, contre 0, abstentions 2

positions.nuance: The vote directly concerns lifting a France-only pesticide ban in the name of a level playing field with foreign competitors. The 2022 ecology booklet did make pesticide authorisations conditional on biodiversity indicators, which is a mild counterpoint.

positions.summary: RN opposes the 2035 end of new combustion-car sales.
positions.nuance: Background knowledge; not verified live because the search budget was exhausted.

positions.summary: RN opposes new environmental taxes and 'punitive ecology'. No specific aviation position was verified.
positions.nuance: Inferred.

positions.summary: Her 2022 ecology booklet rejects 'punitive ecology' and says France would meet Paris targets at its own pace, assessing each year according to other countries' trajectories and the French quality of life.

sources.outlet: M la France (Le Pen 2022 ecology booklet)
sources.quote: Elle appréciera chaque année sa trajectoire de réduction carbone, en fonction des trajectoires des autres pays et de la volonté des Français et de leur qualité de vie

positions.nuance: The 2022 programme makes climate effort conditional on competitiveness and quality of life. The statement is a general trade-off, so the code remains an interpretation, at low confidence.

positions.summary: Her 2022 manifesto pledges to start renewing the nuclear fleet without delay (EPRs, small modular reactors, a revival of fast-neutron research), making nuclear the pivot of energy policy.

sources.outlet: M la France (Le Pen 2022 campaign manifesto)
sources.quote: engager sans tarder le renouvellement de notre parc nucléaire
she supports the construction of new nuclear reactors, including small modular reactors

positions.nuance: 2022 programme. Renewing the whole fleet implies far more than six EPR2. No exact 2026 number was verified.

positions.summary: Le Pen wants to preserve the entire nuclear fleet, extend its lifetime and make nuclear the pivot of energy policy.

sources.outlet: M la France (Le Pen 2022 campaign manifesto)
sources.quote: le parc nucléaire français sera intégralement préservé et sa durée de vie prolongée

positions.nuance: A long-standing, stable position.

positions.summary: Her 2022 programme sets a moratorium on any new wind turbine, onshore or offshore, plus gradual dismantling of existing ones.

sources.outlet: M la France (Le Pen 2022 campaign manifesto)
sources.quote: un moratoire sur la construction de toute nouvelle éolienne, sur terre ou mer, sera instauré dès le printemps 2022 et leur démantèlement engagé progressivement

sources.outlet: M la France (Le Pen 2022 campaign site)
sources.quote: Arrêter les projets éoliens et dé-manteler progressivement les parcs existants.

positions.nuance: The pledge goes beyond halting new developments. It is from the 2022 programme and consistent with later RN statements.

positions.summary: Her 2022 programme promised to leave the European electricity market to bring back decent prices.

sources.outlet: M la France (Le Pen 2022 campaign site)
sources.quote: Sortir du marché européen de l'électricité pour retrouver des prix décents.

positions.nuance: 2022 programme; a 2026 restatement was not verified.

positions.summary: RN does not favour a Sixth Republic. Le Pen favours a strong presidency plus referendums.
positions.nuance: Background knowledge.

positions.summary: Her 2022 programme pledges to introduce proportional representation.

sources.outlet: M la France (Le Pen 2022 campaign site)
sources.quote: Instaurer le Référendum d'Initiative Citoyenne et mettre en place la proportionnelle

positions.nuance: This is a long-standing RN demand, here from the 2022 programme. The RN has floated keeping a majority bonus in some versions, which was not verified.

positions.summary: Her 2022 programme pledges to create a citizens' initiative referendum (RIC).

sources.outlet: M la France (Le Pen 2022 campaign site)
sources.quote: Instaurer le Référendum d'Initiative Citoyenne et mettre en place la proportionnelle

positions.nuance: 2022 programme. The RIC proposed there carried thresholds; not re-verified for 2027.

positions.summary: RN criticises Article 49.3 and wants it curtailed.
positions.nuance: Background knowledge.

positions.summary: Her 2022 manifesto pledges a referendum on immigration within six months of the election, including writing nationality rules and national priority into the Constitution.

sources.outlet: M la France (Le Pen 2022 campaign manifesto)
sources.quote: je demanderai au peuple français d'adopter par référendum un certain nombre de dispositions indispensables

positions.nuance: 2022 programme; the immigration referendum is a constant RN pledge. Justice was not verified.

positions.summary: Le Pen personally voted against the assisted-dying bill on 27 May 2025. RN voted 101 against, 19 for and 3 abstentions, on a free vote. She is described as strictly opposed to euthanasia.

sources.quote: Marine Le Pen (RN, Pas-de-Calais) voted AGAINST (paraphrase of datan record)
She is strictly opposed to euthanasia.

positions.nuance: A free vote within RN, but Le Pen's personal vote was against.

positions.summary: Her 2022 platform referenced her bill against Islamist ideologies, which included banning the headscarf in public space.
positions.nuance: 2022 position. She suggested phasing it in during the 2022 campaign, and whether it stays in the 2027 programme was not verified. The URL was not re-confirmed because the search budget was exhausted.

positions.summary: Her 2022 school booklet calls for a legal ban on the Islamic veil for mothers accompanying school trips.

sources.outlet: M la France (Le Pen 2022 school booklet)
sources.quote: Interdiction par la loi du port du voile islamique pour les accompagnantes de sorties scolaires

positions.nuance: School trips are explicit. Universities are not mentioned there but would be covered by the proposed public-space veil ban. 2022 programme.

positions.summary: RN backs a more restrictive secularism, such as veil bans and specific legislation against Islamist ideologies.
positions.nuance: Inferred from soc2 and soc3.

positions.summary: Her 2022 manifesto says the ban on surrogacy (GPA) will be enforced and may be strengthened.

sources.outlet: M la France (Le Pen 2022 campaign manifesto)
sources.quote: la gestion pour autrui, GPA, dont l'interdiction pourra être renforcée

positions.nuance: The same passage pledges a moratorium of at least three years on societal reforms.

positions.summary: Her 2022 programme introduces a school uniform in primary school and collège.

sources.outlet: M la France (Le Pen 2022 campaign site)
sources.quote: l'instauration d'un uniforme au primaire et au collège

positions.nuance: 2022 programme; it does not cover lycée.

positions.summary: Her 2022 school booklet caps classes at 20 pupils in grande section and CP and at 30 in secondary, and prioritises teacher pay. There is no pledge of mass hiring.

sources.outlet: M la France (Le Pen 2022 school booklet)
sources.quote: l'effectif maximal ne devra plus dépasser 20 élèves par classe. Dans le secondaire, un plafond de trente élèves sera également fixé.

positions.nuance: She supports class-size caps, mostly at existing levels, but does not commit to large-scale recruitment. The record is mixed.

positions.summary: Her 2022 programme calls the collège unique 'a machine for failure' and makes the brevet an orientation exam. Ability grouping is not explicit.
positions.nuance: Inferred from the 2022 school booklet's criticism of the collège unique.

positions.summary: RN defends school freedom.
positions.nuance: Inferred.

positions.summary: RN criticises Parcoursup but favours selectivity and orientation.
positions.nuance: Inferred.

positions.summary: On 2 April 2025 the RN group voted 50-0 against restoring Article 1 of the Garot bill, which regulates where doctors may set up practice. Her 2022 health booklet instead relies on strong financial incentives.

sources.quote: RN group: pour 0, contre 50, abstention 0

sources.outlet: M la France (Le Pen 2022 health booklet)
sources.quote: Réduire le nombre de déserts médicaux grâce à des incitations fi-nancières fortes

positions.nuance: The Garot article regulates installation in over-served areas rather than compelling service in under-served ones. Even so, RN's unanimous opposition plus its incentive-only programme indicates clear opposition to coercion.

positions.summary: RN opposes higher medical co-payments (franchises).
positions.nuance: Background knowledge; not verified live.

positions.summary: RN prefers supply-side housing policy and home ownership.
positions.nuance: Inferred.

positions.summary: Her 2022 programme renationalises motorways and keeps hydroelectricity public under EDF. It denounces the 'competition ideology gone mad' imposed on EDF.

sources.outlet: M la France (Le Pen 2022 campaign manifesto)
sources.quote: au nom d'une idéologie concurrentielle devenue folle
opposed to the privatization of public services and social security

positions.nuance: One exception: the 2022 programme proposes privatising public broadcasting.

Codes without a source (int2, ecol3, ins1, ins4, san2, soc2 URL) could not be re-verified live.

int3: +1 -> +2: the 2022 manifesto says verbatim that France should leave NATO's integrated command, and Boursorama (Oct 2026) confirms she still defends it. Bardella's 2024 caveat is about timing only. The Bardella date was corrected from '2024' to 2024-03-28.
int4: outlet_lean far-left -> campaign-or-party (the source is LFI's own site); the vote description was confirmed with a verbatim quote. Code unchanged (-2, low); uncorroborated by a neutral outlet.

int6: null -> +1 (low, programme): evidence exists. The 2017 programme proposed a compulsory three-month, mainly civic service (Institut Montaigne verbatim). It was absent from 2022.
int7: unchanged (+1, low): the Europe 1 URL now returns HTTP 403 and could not be reopened. The date is unknown and the source is flagged as old.
ecol1: unchanged (+2, high): the LCP vote and quote were confirmed.

ecol5: evidence_type inferred -> programme; a source was added (2022 ecology booklet conditioning the carbon trajectory on other countries and quality of life). Code unchanged.

ene2: the fr.wikipedia RN source did not contain the claim and was replaced with the 2022 manifesto verbatim quote. Code unchanged.

ene4: low -> medium: source added (mlafrance.fr verbatim 'Sortir du marché européen de l'électricité').
ins2: source added (mlafrance.fr measure 11). Code unchanged.
ins3: source added (mlafrance.fr measure 11). Code unchanged.
ins5: source added (2022 manifesto immigration referendum). Code unchanged.

soc2: unchanged (+2, medium): could not re-verify the public-space veil ban live; the nuance now flags that it may have been softened.
soc3: +2 low -> +2 medium; evidence confirmed: the 2022 school booklet verbatim bans the veil for school-trip accompanying mothers. Universities are not explicit.
soc5: medium -> high; party_line -> programme: the 2022 manifesto says verbatim the GPA ban 'pourra être renforcée'.

positions.summary: L'Avenir en commun commits to restoring and strengthening the ISF, adding a climate component. La Facture 2027 (May 2026) confirms this is still the line.

sources.quote: Rétablir et renforcer l'impôt de solidarité sur la fortune (ISF), incluant un volet climatique visant à taxer les gros pollueurs
rétablir l'impôt de solidarité sur la fortune, supprimé en 2018, dans une version élargie intégrant un volet climatique

positions.nuance: The primary text is the 2022 AEC edition; La Facture 2027 (May 2026) shows the measure carried into the 2027 programme. The chapter pages of the 2025 AEC edition on melenchon2027.fr returned 404.

positions.summary: LFI backs the Zucman tax (a 2% floor tax on fortunes above EUR 100m). The left-wide bill passed the Assemblée on 20 Feb 2025, and the tax was rejected as a budget amendment on 31 Oct 2025.

sources.quote: L'ensemble de la gauche, le Parti communiste français, La France insoumise, Les Écologistes, le Parti socialiste et Place publique défendent la mise en œuvre de la taxe Zucman

positions.nuance: The draft cited La Facture 2027 for this claim, but that page does not mention Zucman, so the source was replaced. The support is LFI's group position; the group's own roll-call vote and a personal Mélenchon quote were not opened. LFI's ISF proposal goes further than Zucman.

positions.summary: LFI conditions state aid to firms on social and ecological goals and taxes superprofits; it does not propose cutting production taxes or employer contributions.

sources.quote: Conditionner toute aide d'État aux grandes entreprises à des objectifs sociaux, écologiques et fiscaux contraignants
Taxation des superprofits et des transactions financières

positions.nuance: No direct statement on production taxes or employer contributions was found; the code is inferred from the programme's orientation.

positions.summary: The programme calls for 'protectionnisme écologique et solidaire': tariffs on ecological criteria, emergency anti-dumping measures for strategic industries, and a kilometre tax at the borders.

sources.quote: Instaurer des droits de douane sur des critères écologiques (les émissions carbone et les pollutions, par exemple)
Adopter des mesures antidumping d'urgence sur les industries stratégiques

positions.nuance: The tariffs are framed around ecological criteria and strategic industries rather than classic sector quotas. The price-rise trade-off is not addressed. 2022 edition.

positions.summary: The programme would reverse privatisations, explicitly including motorways and airports, and 2026 summaries list nationalising EDF, ADP and mutual banks.

sources.quote: Revenir sur les privatisations (aéroports, autoroutes, Française des Jeux, etc.)
EDF, ADP, banques mutualistes, parfois télécoms

positions.nuance: Motorways are now confirmed in the primary programme text.

positions.summary: LFI would raise inheritance tax on the largest estates and cap inheritance at about EUR 12m. That is the opposite of a general cut.

sources.quote: Augmenter les droits de succession sur les plus hauts patrimoines [...] et créer un héritage maximal de 12 millions d'euros
héritage maximal (autour de 12 M€ dans les versions précédentes du programme)

positions.nuance: La Facture (2026) mentions a succession reform that favours modest transfers, so relief at the bottom is possible. The overall direction is still higher taxes.

positions.summary: Retirement at 60 after 40 years of contributions is a flagship measure, still listed in 2026.

sources.quote: Restaurer le droit à la retraite à 60 ans à taux plein pour 40 annuités de cotisations
Retraite à 60 ans après 40 années de cotisation

positions.nuance: This goes beyond 62. The draft's melenchon2027.fr/programme/decouvrir page is only a landing page and does not contain the quoted measure, so it was replaced.

positions.summary: Opposes any rise in the retirement age and wants to return to 60.

sources.quote: Restaurer le droit à la retraite à 60 ans à taux plein pour 40 annuités de cotisations
Retraite à 60 ans après 40 années de cotisation

positions.nuance: The programme funds pensions by raising contributions, not by raising the age.

positions.summary: LFI defends pay-as-you-go pensions, funded by higher contributions; it does not propose capitalisation.

sources.quote: Augmenter de 0,25 point par an durant le quinquennat le taux de cotisation vieillesse

positions.nuance: No explicit statement rejecting a funded component was found; the code rests on the long-standing LFI line.

positions.summary: Rejects debt-driven austerity ('refuser le chantage') and says it would disobey EU rules that block the programme.

sources.quote: La dette publique est instrumentalisée pour justifier l'austérité et les privatisations.
nous désobéirons aux règles européennes incompatibles avec l'application de l'Avenir en commun

positions.nuance: The draft's melenchon2027.fr/plans-2022/europe/ URL returns 404 and was replaced. The draft's claim that La Grande Conversation reported a Sept 2026 debt-cancellation plan was removed, because that article (19 Aug 2026) is about foreign policy only.

positions.summary: The programme proposes hiring more civil servants (e.g. in justice) and raising their pay; it has no plan to cut their numbers.

sources.quote: Planifier des moyens pour la justice et recruter davantage de fonctionnaires : magistrats, greffiers, agents de la protection judiciaire de la jeunesse
Revaloriser le traitement des fonctionnaires

positions.nuance: 2022 edition.

positions.summary: Calls public debt a pretext for austerity, wants the ECB to convert the state debt it holds into perpetual zero-rate debt, and backs heavy public investment and services.

sources.quote: Exiger de l'Union européenne que la Banque centrale européenne (BCE) transforme la part de dette des États qu'elle possède en dettes perpétuelles à taux nul

positions.nuance: The draft's only source (La Grande Conversation) contains nothing about debt and was removed, along with the unverified Banque de France claim. The programme treats debt as no obstacle rather than saying 'more debt' outright.

positions.summary: LFI opposes deficit rules and austerity, so it would oppose a constitutional golden rule.
positions.nuance: No source was opened that addresses a constitutional golden rule directly; the code rests on the party line and the anti-austerity programme (see fin1).

positions.summary: SMIC at EUR 1,600 net from day one in the 2027 version, up from EUR 1,400 net in 2022.

sources.quote: SMIC à 1 600€ net dès le premier jour
Porter immédiatement le SMIC mensuel à 1 400 euros nets

positions.nuance: The figure rose from EUR 1,400 (2022) to EUR 1,600 (2027 summaries).

positions.summary: The programme would restore 'protective' unemployment insurance, reverse the Macron reforms and pay benefits from the first day.

sources.quote: Refuser la réforme Macron : indemniser les chômeurs en fonction de leurs derniers salaires grâce à une assurance calculée à partir du premier jour de travail

positions.nuance: 2022 edition; it also removes the obligation to accept a 'reasonable job offer'.

positions.summary: LFI opposes making the RSA conditional on activity hours and instead proposes an unconditional 'garantie d'autonomie' at the poverty line.

sources.quote: Créer une garantie d'autonomie qui permettra que nul ne soit privé de sa dignité pour vivre

positions.nuance: No direct statement on RSA activity hours was opened; the adjacent programme measure supports the code.

positions.summary: The programme restores the 35-hour week, moves arduous and night work to 32 hours, and pushes to generalise 32 hours through collective bargaining.

sources.quote: passer aux 32 heures dans les métiers pénibles ou de nuit, et favoriser leur généralisation par la négociation collective

positions.nuance: This is the 2022 edition; it was not confirmed in the 2026 summaries. Generalisation goes through negotiation rather than a legal 32-hour week.

positions.summary: The programme would make visas easier to get, regularise many undocumented people and make the 10-year residence card the standard permit. It refuses numerical caps on legal immigration.

sources.quote: Faciliter l'accès aux visas, régulariser les travailleurs, étudiants, parents d'enfants scolarisés et instituer la carte de séjour de dix ans
refuse toute limitation chiffrée de l'immigration légale

positions.nuance: 2022 edition; MonVote2027 (2026) is consistent with it.

positions.summary: Backs a citizen-initiated referendum (RIC) on any subject but does not propose a referendum on immigration and rejects restrictive immigration agendas.

sources.quote: Instaurer le Référendum d'initiative citoyenne (RIC), par lequel les citoyens [...] peuvent révoquer des élus, proposer ou abroger une loi

positions.nuance: No direct statement on an immigration referendum was found. A RIC could in principle allow one.

positions.summary: LFI opposes any removal or restriction of the AME.

sources.quote: opposition totale à toute suppression ou restriction

positions.nuance: MonVote2027 cites an article dated 2025-11-06; the primary vote was not opened.

positions.summary: The programme would regularise undocumented workers, students and parents of schooled children.

sources.quote: régulariser les travailleurs, étudiants, parents d'enfants scolarisés
régularisation des sans-papiers, fin des centres de rétention administrative

positions.nuance: Broader than labour-shortage occupations.

positions.summary: LFI rejects national preference and defends universal equality of rights.

sources.quote: L'universalité des droits n'est pas négociable en République

positions.nuance: No explicit mention of social housing priority; the code rests on the universalist principle and the party line.

positions.summary: The programme guarantees full droit du sol for every child born in France.

sources.quote: Garantir le droit du sol intégral à tous les enfants nés en France et faciliter l'accès à la nationalité française

positions.nuance: 2022 edition.

positions.summary: The programme gives foreign residents the right to vote in local elections.

sources.quote: Instituer le droit de vote des étrangers aux élections locales
accorder le droit de vote aux élections locales à tous les étrangers résidant en France

positions.nuance: The draft said this was limited to residents in a regular situation, but neither source states that limit.

positions.summary: LFI opposes minimum sentences (peines planchers) and focuses on prison overcrowding and reintegration.

sources.quote: s'oppose structurellement aux peines planchers

positions.nuance: The aggregator attributes this to an Assemblée vote of 2024-09-17, but that roll call could not be verified. Evidence type was downgraded from vote to party_line.

positions.summary: LFI opposes trying minors as adults and wants more juvenile protection staff (PJJ).
positions.nuance: No source opened on this exact point; party line. The programme only mentions recruiting PJJ staff.

positions.summary: The programme would abolish the IGPN and IGGN and replace them with an independent authority attached to the Défenseur des droits.

sources.quote: Supprimer l'Inspection générale de la Police nationale (IGPN) et l'Inspection générale de la Gendarmerie nationale (IGGN) et les remplacer par une autorité indépendante

positions.nuance: MonVote2027 indicates the measure remains in the 2025 programme.

positions.summary: Legalise recreational cannabis and regulate it through a state monopoly.

sources.quote: Légaliser et encadrer par un monopole d'État la consommation, la production et la vente de cannabis à des fins récréatives
"Il faut légaliser le cannabis."

positions.nuance: Sources date from 2021-2022. A 2026 summary (TestPolitique) says 'dépénalisation', but no newer reversal was found.

positions.summary: The programme would ban all facial recognition in public spaces, including experiments.

sources.quote: Interdire dans la loi tout usage des technologies de reconnaissance faciale dans les espaces et établissements publics

positions.nuance: Facial recognition is a subset of AI video surveillance; the broader opposition is party line.

positions.summary: The programme would reaffirm that the constitution's fundamental principles override EU law, and apply a non-regression rule against EU norms that are less ambitious.

sources.quote: Réaffirmer la supériorité des principes fondamentaux inscrits dans la Constitution de la 6e République sur le droit européen

positions.nuance: This applies to constitutional principles and social or ecological non-regression, not blanket primacy of all French law, hence +1. The draft's 404 URL was replaced.

positions.summary: No evidence found on EU joint borrowing.
positions.nuance: The draft coded 0 with no source. Under the coding rules, 0 means explicitly mixed, so the absence of evidence must be coded null.

positions.summary: The programme makes France's EU budget contribution conditional and treats it as a lever in negotiations.

sources.quote: Conditionner la contribution française au budget de l'Union européenne

positions.nuance: This is conditional leverage, not an outright commitment to cut, hence +1. 2022 edition.

positions.summary: The programme relies on France's veto as a lever, which implies keeping unanimity.

sources.quote: Utiliser le droit de veto de la France, par exemple pour refuser tout nouvel accord de libre-échange

positions.nuance: The veto passage concerns trade and enlargement, not foreign policy specifically, so the code is inferred.

positions.summary: The programme sets out an explicit strategy of disobeying EU rules that block it.

sources.quote: nous désobéirons aux règles européennes incompatibles avec l'application de l'Avenir en commun
désobéissance européenne
Paraphrase: willingness to contravene European rules to apply a rupture programme.

positions.nuance: The draft's melenchon2027.fr/plans-2022/europe/ URL returns 404 and was replaced.

positions.summary: The strategy is to stay in the EU: negotiate treaty change while disobeying blocking rules, then put any deal to a referendum. Leaving is not proposed.

sources.quote: Tant qu'un accord de changement des traités n'est pas acquis, nous discutons avec nos partenaires et désobéissons aux règles bloquantes en parallèle.

positions.nuance: No explicit 'we will not leave' quote was opened, so -1 is kept. The 2017 'plan B' exit option does not appear in the 2022 text. The draft's 404 URL was replaced.

verification_notes: Primary source added: L'Avenir en commun 2022 edition sections on laec.fr (fetched; URLs from laec.fr/sommaire). The 2025-edition chapter pages on melenchon2027.fr return 404; the 2026 aggregators La Facture and TestPolitique confirm continuity on ISF, retirement at 60, SMIC, nationalisations and EU disobedience.
No web searches were possible in this session (budget exhausted), so null and party-line items were checked through fetched pages only.

result.bio: Gabriel Attal (born 16 March 1989) is a Renaissance politician who started on the Socialist side and later joined Emmanuel Macron's movement. He held several government posts from 2018 and became France's youngest Prime Minister on 9 January 2024. President Macron accepted his resignation on 16 July 2024, after the June-July 2024 snap legislative elections. He then ran a caretaker government until Michel Barnier was appointed on 5 September 2024. He has chaired the Ensemble pour la République group in the Assemblée nationale since July 2024 and has been Renaissance general secretary since December 2024. He announced his 2027 presidential candidacy on 22 May 2026 in Mur-de-Barrez (Aveyron).

offices.office: Secretary of State to the Minister of National Education and Youth
Deputy, Hauts-de-Seine 10th constituency (second term, gave up the seat to stay in government)
Minister of National Education and Youth
Prime Minister (resignation accepted 16 July 2024, caretaker until 5 September 2024)
President of the Ensemble pour la République group, Assemblée nationale

delivery.what: Abaya and qamis ban in public schools (Education Minister, announced late August 2023, applied from the September 2023 school start)
delivery.assessment: The government presented it as a secularism (laïcité) measure. According to Wikipedia, 67 pupils were refused entry at the school start. Left-wing parties and Muslim organisations objected. It is often cited as a defining act of his time at Education. Only encyclopedic sources were checked, so this lacks a multi-outlet assessment from different leanings.

delivery.what: 'Choc des savoirs' education reform, announced December 2023 (including level-based groups in 6e and 5e) and a school-uniform experiment in about 10 schools, announced autumn 2023
delivery.assessment: Both were launched under his authority as Education Minister and then as PM. According to Wikipedia, the level-based groups were dropped about two years later as ineffective and the uniform experiment was abandoned in summer 2026. Later governments made both decisions. No primary or second source was found for the outcome, so the result is reported only, without a verdict.

delivery.what: Premiership (9 January - 16 July 2024, then caretaker until 5 September 2024)
delivery.assessment: He started with a 15-member government on 11 January 2024, which grew to 35 members on 8 February 2024. Several ministers had served under Nicolas Sarkozy or came from UMP/LR. English Wikipedia says many outlets called it the most right-leaning cabinet of Macron's tenure. Ensemble came third with 20.0% in the first round of the 30 June 2024 legislative elections. Attal later said eight months had been too little time to see his plans through.

delivery.what: Agricultural and environmental decisions as PM (early 2024)
delivery.assessment: According to English Wikipedia, his government suspended and then modified the Ecophyto pesticide-reduction plan after pressure from farmers, and cut environmental budget lines including the Green Fund. Environmental groups and the left criticised these moves. No statement of the government's rationale and no source from another leaning was retrieved, so this is one-sided.

media_portrayal.left_media: Not researched: no left-leaning outlet could be consulted. Wikipedia reports that the left criticised the abaya ban and the 2024 environmental rollbacks.
media_portrayal.right_media: Not researched: no right-leaning outlet could be consulted.
media_portrayal.neutral_media: Not researched beyond encyclopedic summaries. English Wikipedia reports that early in his premiership he was described as one of France's most popular politicians.

result.sources_note:
Both the original research and this verification pass ran with the WebSearch budget exhausted, so no news outlet was reached. Five pages were checked:
- fr.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gabriel_Attal
- en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gabriel_Attal
- fr.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gouvernement_Gabriel_Attal
- his Assemblée nationale page (assemblee-nationale.fr/dyn/deputes/PA722190), which confirms his current seat and his role as EPR group president
- the campaign site attalpresident.fr

The campaign site uses the slogan "La force d'agir". It sets out four themes:
- reducing the debt
- education and youth
- removing obstacles to growth
- fairness between generations

It also announces a Lyon meeting on 10 October 2026.

Legal: no judicial case appears in the sources checked. This shows only that none was found in limited sources; it does not prove a clean record.

Not covered:
- reversals, traits and media portrayal
- assurance chômage, the immigration law, pension votes and the public-finances record

Bias caveat: all content comes from secondary encyclopedic sources plus the candidate's own site. A rerun with a search budget and outlets of different leanings is needed before publishing.

result.bio: Bruno Retailleau (born 20 November 1960 in Cholet) is a conservative politician from the Vendée and has been president of Les Républicains since May 2025. He was senator for Vendée from 2004 to 2024 and again from November 2025. He chaired the Vendée departmental council (2010-2015) and the Pays de la Loire region (2015-2017), led the LR group in the Senate (2014-2024), and was Interior Minister in the Barnier, Bayrou and short-lived Lecornu I governments (September 2024 - October 2025). He declared his 2027 presidential candidacy on 12 February 2026 and was designated LR candidate after the party vote of 19 April 2026. He is known for a restrictive line on immigration and security and for socially conservative positions.

offices.office: Member of the National Assembly (Vendée, 4th constituency)
Vice-president of the Pays de la Loire regional council
President of the Vendée departmental council
Chair of the UMP/LR group in the Senate
President of the Pays de la Loire regional council
Minister of the Interior (Barnier, Bayrou, Lecornu I governments; Minister of State from 23 Dec 2024)

reversals.before: In 2022 he refused any governing agreement with Macron's Renaissance party, saying the right is 'not soluble in Macronism'.
reversals.after: In September 2024 he became Interior Minister in Michel Barnier's government, a coalition of LR and the presidential camp, and stayed under Bayrou; he left in October 2025 over the composition of the Lecornu government.

delivery.what: Anti-narcotics plan (announced November 2024 with Justice Minister Migaud) and backing for the Senate bill 'sortir la France du piège du narcotrafic' (Blanc/Durain): creation of a national anti-organised-crime prosecutor's office (PNACO) and reform of informant status. Adopted on 29 April 2025 and promulgated on 13 June 2025.
delivery.assessment: The law came from a cross-party Senate bill. Retailleau defended it, at first with Justice Minister Darmanin. It passed the Senate unanimously and the Assembly 396-68. The Conseil constitutionnel struck down the algorithmic-intelligence provisions. Socialist senator Carlotti backed the core measures but criticised his remarks on cutting social benefits and the lack of funding (Public Sénat). Evidence on outcomes is not covered in the sources read.

delivery.what: Immigration enforcement: negotiations with Iraq, Kazakhstan and Egypt on removals were announced (8 Oct 2024), along with an arrangement with Morocco to speed up returns (29 Oct 2024). A circular of 29 Oct 2024 asked prefects for 'complète mobilisation' on removals, and he announced the end of the Valls regularisation circular (Oct 2024). He also took a firm line with Algeria on readmissions.
delivery.assessment: Supporters see this as tougher enforcement. Critics inside the presidential camp objected to his remark that the rule of law is neither 'intangible' nor 'sacré'. The sources are Wikipedia summaries, so the agreements' contents and actual removal figures are not verified.

media_portrayal.left_media: Not directly verified: Libération, Mediapart and L'Humanité were not read. The secondary sources read report that his 2023 'Français de papier' remark and his rule-of-law comment drew wide criticism from opponents.
media_portrayal.right_media: Not verified: no right-leaning outlet was read, so no characterisation is given.
media_portrayal.neutral_media: Public Sénat (Nov 2024) reports his narcotics plan procedurally and gives room to a Socialist senator's partial support and criticism.

result.bio: Éric Zemmour, born 31 August 1958 in Montreuil, is a French journalist, essayist and politician. He worked at Le Figaro, RTL, Paris Première and CNews before founding Reconquête in December 2021. He finished fourth in the 2022 presidential election with 7.07% and confirmed his 2027 candidacy on BFM TV on 17 September 2026. Reconquête is classed as far-right and national-conservative, and campaigns on "zero immigration", assimilation and Euroscepticism.

offices.office: Candidate in Var 4th constituency (3rd, eliminated first round, 23.19%)

legal.case: Provocation à la discrimination raciale (March 2010 remarks on Canal+ 'Salut les Terriens' and France Ô): 17e chambre, tribunal de Paris, 18 Feb 2011, 1,000 EUR suspended fine in each of two judgments plus damages; Zemmour announced on 1 March 2011 he would not appeal

Provocation à la haine religieuse envers les musulmans (France 5 'C à vous', Sept 2016): cour d'appel de Paris 3 May 2018, 5,000 EUR fine; pourvoi rejected by the Cour de cassation 17 Sept 2019; ECHR (Zemmour v. France) found no violation of Article 10 on 20 Dec 2022

Complicité d'injure publique et provocation à la haine (CNews 'Face à l'info', Sept 2020 remarks on unaccompanied migrant minors): tribunal de Paris 17 Jan 2022, 10,000 EUR (100 day-fines of 100 EUR); confirmed on appeal; pourvoi rejected by the Cour de cassation 2 Dec 2025

Injure publique et provocation à la haine raciale (speech at the 'Convention de la droite', 28 Sept 2019): convicted at first instance 25 Sept 2020, acquitted on appeal 8 Sept 2021, acquittal quashed by the Cour de cassation 21 Feb 2023, convicted on retrial by the cour d'appel de Paris 22 Feb 2024 (15,000 EUR fine); pourvoi rejected 16 Sept 2025

Injure à caractère raciste against Hapsatou Sy: tribunal de Paris 12 Jan 2023, 4,000 EUR fine; confirmed by the cour d'appel de Paris 28 March 2024; pourvoi rejected by the Cour de cassation 2 Sept 2025

Diffamation against lawyer Patrick Klugman (April 2022 France 2 remarks on the death of Jérémie Cohen): convicted Jan 2024, 1,000 EUR fine; confirmed on appeal Dec 2024; pourvoi rejected by the Cour de cassation 2 Dec 2025

Complicité de diffamation publique envers une administration publique (INED; April 2021 CNews claim that INED 'trafique les chiffres'): tribunal de Paris 29 Jan 2024, 1,500 EUR suspended fine; confirmed on appeal 11 Dec 2024; pourvoi rejected by the Cour de cassation 27 Jan 2026

Complicité de diffamation publique against MP Danièle Obono (2020 CNews remarks): tribunal correctionnel de Paris 7 Feb 2024, 1,000 EUR suspended fine; confirmed on appeal Jan 2025; Cour de cassation confirmed the case in June 2026

Injure raciale (remarks after the Crépol killing): tribunal correctionnel de Paris 26 March 2025, 9,000 EUR (60 day-fines of 150 EUR); acquitted on other counts; Zemmour announced an appeal. Appeal outcome not verified

Contestation de crime contre l'humanité (Oct 2019 CNews claim that Pétain 'saved French Jews'): acquitted at first instance (4 Feb 2021) and on appeal (May 2022); acquittal quashed by the Cour de cassation 5 Sept 2023; convicted on retrial by the cour d'appel de Paris 2 April 2025, 10,000 EUR fine; Zemmour announced a pourvoi en cassation. Cassation outcome not verified

Civil judgment for contrefaçon de droits d'auteur and atteinte au droit moral (film extracts in his campaign announcement video): tribunal judiciaire de Paris 4 March 2022, Zemmour and Reconquête ordered to pay about 70,000 EUR to Gaumont, EuropaCorp, Luc Besson, SACD and others; no appeal filed
Contrefaçon de droits d'auteur (unauthorised extracts of the documentary 'Le Collège d'à côté'): judgment of 16 Jan 2026; court, amount and appeal status not verified

Injure homophobe (Oct 2019 CNews remarks): convicted at first instance 28 Sept 2023 (4,000 EUR), acquitted by the cour d'appel de Paris 12 Sept 2024; a civil party (Stop Homophobie) said it would file a pourvoi
Provocation à la discrimination (Jan 2022 Public Sénat remarks on immigration and crime), prosecuted by LDH and SOS Racisme: acquitted by the tribunal correctionnel de Paris
Diffamation (Feb 2022 France Inter remarks comparing French towns to Afghanistan): acquitted 12 Nov 2024, acquittal confirmed on appeal Oct 2025; Vitry-sur-Seine filed a pourvoi
Contestation de crime contre l'humanité (book passage calling the deportation of homosexuals from France a 'légende'): acquitted 18 Sept 2025; plaintiffs' appeal dismissed June 2026
Diffamation against teacher Sophie Djigo (2022), tried with nine RN officials 30-31 March 2026: acquitted June 2026; the teacher announced an appeal
Prosecution before the 17e chambre for 2021 and 2022 CNews remarks about Senegalese crack dealers (renvoi ordered May 2024). Trial outcome not verified

delivery.what: He has held no national or local executive or legislative office, so his record is electoral. He won 7.07% in the 2022 presidential first round. In the 2022 legislative elections Reconquête won no seats; its national share is given as 4.24% in the draft and 3.61% on Reconquête's Wikipedia page. In the 2024 European elections it won 5.47% and 5 MEPs.
delivery.assessment: He founded a party that has lasted since December 2021 but has won no seats in the National Assembly. Four of its five MEPs elected in 2024 (Marion Maréchal, Nicolas Bay, Guillaume Peltier and Laurence Trochu) were expelled in June 2024 after calling for support of the RN-led right-wing coalition; Sarah Knafo stayed. Only Wikipedia was checked for this item, so no balanced assessment from sources of different leanings is available.

media_portrayal.left_media: Only partly verified. Mediapart (left) reported the final Obono defamation ruling as the latest in a long list of sanctions. Its standfirst reads: 'Dernière sanction d'une longue liste'. Libération (centre-left) also covers each conviction in detail (headlines seen in Wikipedia citations). No wider sample was checked.
media_portrayal.right_media: Not verified. No CNews, Europe 1, JDD or Valeurs actuelles coverage was opened this session, so their portrayal is not documented here. Le Figaro (centre-right) covered the 2022 ECHR ruling and the 2025 Pétain conviction in factual headlines (URL slugs only; the pages could not be fetched).
media_portrayal.neutral_media: Partly verified. franceinfo calls him the 'candidat d'extrême droite' and reports his convictions and their final status factually. AFP dispatches (via L'Obs) and France 24 report court decisions without adding commentary.

result.sources_note: WebSearch was unavailable (the session's 200-call quota was used up), so verification relied on direct fetches. These were the raw text of the French Wikipedia pages on Zemmour, Reconquête and the 2027 election, plus the cited articles that could be opened or checked by HTTP status: franceinfo, AFP via L'Obs, France 24, BFM TV, Radio France, Le Dauphiné, Le Club des juristes, ActuaLitté, Mediapart (metadata only), courdecassation.fr, and Le Figaro (HTTP 200, but the content could not be fetched). Le Monde and Libération pages block automated access, so they are not cited. Legal statuses come from court decisions reported up to mid-2026. Two convictions are still under appeal: the Crépol case on appeal and the Pétain case at cassation. Their later outcomes, if any, could not be checked and should be rechecked before publication. No right-leaning outlet was opened, so media_portrayal is unbalanced by omission, and traits and reversals stay empty for lack of sources of more than one leaning.
